name: Buckflower Plot
description: Cultivation plot adjusted for growing Buckflowers, with a higher chance of Firebuckle. Soil quality is far better than the average arable land in Valley IV. The wiki does not list a structured in-game recipe for operating the plot; the only Crafting table on the wiki is for building the plot itself (Buckflower Seed + Carbon -> Buckflower Plot). Rarity 2.
